source_note: 黎曼积分与黎曼和的误差
english_source_note: Errors in Riemann Integrals and Riemann Sums
callout_id: 黎曼积分与黎曼和的误差#1
statement_en:
Let $f\in C^2([0,1])$, and define
$$R_n:=\int_0^1 f(t)\,\mathrm{d}t-\frac1n\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} f(k/n).$$
Find
$$\lim_{n\to\infty} nR_n.$$
key_techniques: comparison between integral and left-endpoint Riemann sum
